name: Balticon
blurb: Maryland's science fiction & fantasy convention since 1967, with 300+ hours of programming, an art show, masquerade and gaming in Baltimore's Inner Harbor.

picks: The Book of Lost Hours; 2026 Compton Crook winner
Music Guest of Honor; Portland pop-folk trio

editions.evidence: Homepage + hotel page text: "BALTICON 61 MAY 28 - 31, 2027"; "Balticon will once again be at the Renaissance Baltimore Harborplace Hotel ... 202 East Pratt Street, Baltimore, MD 21202"

notes: The 2027 Guest of Honor, Robert A. Heinlein Award recipient, Compton Crook Winner and one Special Guest slot are all still teased as "Guess Who?" (hidden, with a reveal-later photo placeholder) on the official Guests of Honor page, so those are excluded as not yet announced; only the two already-named guests (the Music Guest of Honor and the 2026 Compton Crook winner invited as a special guest) are recorded. An aggregator site gave different dates (May 21-24, 2027); the official site's own text (May 28-31, 2027) was used instead per the research rules.
